title: SGS 3 Ton Low Profile Trolley Jack 85–500mm

overview.text: The SGS 3 Ton Low Profile Trolley Jack is designed for vehicles with limited ground clearance, with a minimum height of 85mm and a maximum lift height of 500mm.

features.benefit: Suits sports cars and lowered vehicles
Helps protect against overload during lifting

faqs.question: What is the lifting capacity?
faqs.answer: This trolley jack has a 3 tonne capacity.

faqs.question: What ground clearance does it need?
faqs.answer: The minimum height is 85mm, so it suits vehicles with limited ground clearance.

faqs.question: Does it include overload protection?
faqs.answer: Yes, it includes a safety overload valve.

site_benefits.text: UK customer support from SGS Engineering
Delivery options and return policy available
